overview_description.description:
Lumari is an AI platform for direct procurement and supplier operations. It deploys always-on AI agents that handle does the actual tactical work — purchase order tracking, supplier follow-ups, order acknowledgment monitoring, RFQ distribution, quote extraction from supplier emails and PDFs, and response normalization into side-by-side comparisons.

Lumari runs through email, so suppliers don't need to adopt a new portal. It sits on top of existing ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, NetSuite etc with no migration or rip-and-replace required. Procurement teams stay in control of decisions while Lumari handles the execution layer: chasing quotes, confirming ship dates, flagging delivery risks, and keeping systems of record up to date.
